conclusion: Saved weights and features are healthy: in fresh processes the same checkpoints give normal CE/outputs and training progresses. The live process became corrupt mid-way through epoch2 dev generation (abruptly at dev clip216) and stayed corrupt, so logged CE and every later dev report reflected the corrupted in-memory state. Deterministic replay did not reproduce it. Root cause of the in-memory corruption (e.g. transient GPU/driver fault under WSL) is not identified; no kernel/driver error was logged.
